description: Montani semper liberi: Mountaineers are always free. That’s our state motto, and we’re rightly suspicious of a government that grows too powerful and has so much information about you that it can control your life, your choices, and your thoughts. George Orwell’s “1984,” a high school literature standard, is a book that describes a society with such control. title: Mountaineers can’t be free with ongoing collusion between Big Tech and government
